incident.title: Isolated notification-template rendering errors
incident.alert_or_symptom: A small number of notification messages using one promotional template are failing to render, while normal notification processing remains available.

technical_evidence.observation: Fourteen messages using template PROMO-V4 generated an unhandled TemplateRenderException between 16:22 and 16:28.
The Notification Service processed 12,386 of 12,400 messages successfully during the same period, giving a success rate of 99.89 percent.
The Message Broker, Application Compute Cluster and External Email and SMS Provider are healthy and operating normally.
The rendering issue is limited to one internal promotional test campaign; transactional customer notifications are unaffected.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Fourteen internal promotional test messages failed to render; production transactional notifications continue to process normally.
service_impact.geographic_scope: Internal United Kingdom marketing test account
service_impact.workaround_description: The campaign operator can use another existing approved template for the test messages.

environmental_context: The Notification Service consumes events from the Message Broker and sends messages through the External Email and SMS Provider.
Production transactional notification templates continue to operate normally.

recent_changes.description: A Notification Service template-parser update was deployed at 15:55.

additional_context: No failed transactional notifications, customer-facing outage, data loss or security exposure has been observed.
